title: Buddy Strings
description: Two strings are buddy strings if swapping exactly two distinct positions in `s` makes it equal to `goal`. If the strings already match, the swap must exchange two equal characters. Return whether `s` and `goal` are buddy strings. Input: lowercase strings `s` and `goal`. Output: true or false.
constraints: s and goal contain only lowercase English letters
hints: Keep track of the smallest state needed to continue matching or comparing characters.
Test empty, one-character, repeated-character, and boundary inputs.
